T005 : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : WaveMap.Space n × ℝ → WaveMap.Space m) (q : WaveMap.Space m),
  ((∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → Integrable (fun x => WaveMap.density u x t) volume) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => WaveMap.density u p.1 p.2) (WaveMap.positive n) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => WaveMap.densityTime u p.1 p.2) (WaveMap.positive n) ∧
          ∀ (t0 : ℝ),
            0 < t0 →
              ∃ C R η B,
                IsCompact C ∧
                  0 < R ∧
                    0 < η ∧
                      0 ≤ B ∧
                        C ⊆ WaveMap.openBox n R ∧
                          IsCompact (WaveMap.box n R) ∧
                            volume (WaveMap.box n R) = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * R) ^ n) ∧
                              volume (WaveMap.box n R) ≠ ⊤ ∧
                                Icc (t0 - η) (t0 + η) ⊆ WaveMap.timeInterior t0 ∧
                                  (∀ x ∉ C, ∀ r ∈ WaveMap.timeInterval t0, u (x, r) = q) ∧
                                    (∀ (k : ℕ) (x : WaveMap.Space n) (r : ℝ),
                                        0 < k → x ∉ C → r ∈ WaveMap.timeInterior t0 → iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u (x, r) = 0) ∧
                                      (∀ r ∈ WaveMap.timeInterior t0,
                                          ∀ (j : Fin n),
                                            ∀ f ∈ WaveMap.terms u r j,
                                              Continuous f ∧
                                                Function.support f ⊆ C ∧
                                                  (∃ K, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ x ∈ WaveMap.box n R, |f x| ≤ K) ∧
                                                    Measurable f ∧ Integrable f volume) ∧
                                        ∀ x ∈ WaveMap.box n R,
                                          ∀ r ∈ Icc (t0 - η) (t0 + η), |WaveMap.densityTime u x r| ≤ B) →
    (∀ (x : WaveMap.Space n) (t : ℝ),
        0 < t →
          HasDerivAt (WaveMap.density u x) (WaveMap.densityTime u x t) t ∧
            WaveMap.densityTime u x t = 2 * WaveMap.kineticProduct u t x + 2 * ∑ j, WaveMap.gradientProduct u j t x) →
      ∀ (t0 : ℝ),
        0 < t0 →
          ∃ R η B,
            0 < R ∧
              0 < η ∧
                0 ≤ B ∧
                  Icc (t0 - η) (t0 + η) ⊆ Ioi 0 ∧
                    Integrable (WaveMap.bound n R B) volume ∧
                      ∀ (h : ℝ),
                        0 < |h| → |h| < η → ∀ (x : WaveMap.Space n), |WaveMap.quotient u t0 h x| ≤ WaveMap.bound n R B x
